scripts.preinstall: node -e "const ua=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||''; if (!ua.startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm install.'); process.exit(1); }"

scripts.deploy:preview:admin: pnpm --filter ziot-admin exec wrangler versions upload
